title: Orthogonal crypto sleeves, round 2: macro timing of BTC/ETH and ETH/BTC relative trend (4 trials)

trials.A dollar timing: USD index proxy = mean daily log change of USDJPY, USDCAD, USDCHF, 1/EURUSD, 1/GBPUSD, 1/AUDUSD (Dukascopy, day = UTC); if its 21-day change < 0 (dollar weakening) -> long BTC and ETH 0.5 each the next day, else flat
trials.B rates timing: CME 10-year note (ZN) 21-day return > 0 (yields falling) -> long BTC and ETH 0.5 each the next day (signal from the last completed US session), else flat
trials.C macro agreement: long BTC/ETH 0.5 only on days where A and B both signal
trials.D ETH/BTC relative trend: ETH/BTC ratio above its 50-day mean -> long ETH 0.5 / short BTC 0.5, below -> the reverse; daily

bars: orthogonal candidate: sleeve DEV (2020-22) > 0, TEST (2023-24) >= 0.8, HOLD (2025-26) >= 0.5 and |daily correlation with v8.6 2022-26| <= 0.2
